reason: The primary CIF parses as an ordered primitive P1 cell with 10 fully occupied sites, Z=1, formula AlBi2Se2BrCl4, and the stated 10.80062 x 7.07634 x 4.17123 A triclinic cell; symmetry expansion and standardization do not change its atom count or reveal a supercell. Indexing is strong (25/25 low-angle lines, M(25)=72.8, F(25)=143.8, and 92/92 robust peaks within 0.03 degrees). The trace instantiated and refined atomic structure factors against both the profile and extracted intensities, with repeated searches converging on the same P1 topology and quantitatively rejecting tested centrosymmetric branches. Independent whole-profile evaluation gives R_profile about 9.3% for selected.cif versus a Pawley-like 6.7% floor, with no important unindexed reflections; selected is also the best of all fixed-coordinate Al/Cl/Se/Br orderings. The only near-degenerate Se/Br permutations are explicitly supplied as alternatives. Stoichiometry and charge balance are exact, periodic contacts have no atomic overlaps, and bond-valence/complete-shell checks support Al(III), Bi(III), chalcogenide, and halide chemistry despite distorted coordination. No concrete incompatible viable branch survives outside the submitted set.
